strategies.name: opening_range_fvg_retest_scalp_5m_1m

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: mark out the high and the low of the first 5-minute candle
entry_sequence.action: Mark the high and low of the first 5-minute candle of the day as the key levels.
entry_sequence.rationale: These levels define the opening range used for the setup.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: wait for a break of the level, but we need a fair value gap
entry_sequence.action: Wait for price to break one of the marked opening-range levels only when a fair value gap forms with the break.
entry_sequence.rationale: The break alone is not enough; the fair value gap confirms the move.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: we need the market to trade back into the fair value gap
entry_sequence.action: Wait for price to retest back into the fair value gap.
entry_sequence.rationale: The retest is the pullback required before entry.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: wait for this retest candle right here to get engulfed
entry_sequence.action: Enter when the retest candle is engulfed in the breakout direction.
entry_sequence.rationale: Engulfing provides confirmation that buyers or sellers remain in control.

stop.transcript_quote: put that under the lowest area that we traded into that fair value gap. And you always want to give it one tick of breathing room
stop.rationale: "put that under the lowest area that we traded into that fair value gap" with "one tick of breathing room".

strategies.stop_management: No need to micromanage your trade.

targets.transcript_quote: we are just targeting a fixed 3:1 return
targets.rationale: The speaker says the scalping target is a fixed 3:1 return.
